ActorTalk: As expected of the Gray Raven Commandant, so efficient and reliable! Let me import this right away... Yup, no issues at all. Hey, I'm pretty good at this myself.

Well, the thing about good security is that you can't call it "good" if something bad actually happens. Honestly, sometimes I get really worried that people would think I don't actually do anything and slash the security budget!
By the way, you didn't run into any problems during the test, did you?
The robot in the terminal control room? Oh, that's my assistant robot Kuriri. Quite the lively fella, right?
You're saying it fell in love with the system mainframe? Umm... But considering their classifications, there should be protocols in place to isolate them... Wait... do they...?
Whatever, if it's true love, then it's fine, haha!
Anyway, I really can't thank you enough for your help. Here's your payment, as promised.
